title: Ordering Coffee: Size, Hot or Iced

vocabulary.meaning_en: coffee made with espresso and a lot of hot milk
vocabulary.example: I would like a latte, please.
I want a large orange juice.
I like iced coffee in summer.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the thick white part of milk
vocabulary.example: Would you like cream with that?

vocabulary.meaning_en: how big or small something is
what you ask to buy in a café
vocabulary.example: Your order will be ready soon.

vocabulary.meaning_en: said when you give something to someone

fine_lines.title: hot vs iced
fine_lines.explanation_ar: hot يعني ساخن، وiced يعني بارد بالثلج. نسأل: Would you like it hot or iced?
fine_lines.explanation_en: "Hot" means very warm. "Iced" means cold with ice.

fine_lines.title: small, medium, large
fine_lines.explanation_ar: ثلاثة أحجام للمشروبات: small صغير، medium متوسط، large كبير.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Three drink sizes: small, medium and large.

expressions.meaning_ar: مرحبًا بك في مقهى كوفي كورنر.

expressions.meaning_en: The worker asks what you want to order.
expressions.example: What would you like to drink?

expressions.phrase: What can I get for you?
expressions.meaning_en: Another way to ask for your order.
expressions.example: Hi! What can I get for you today?

expressions.phrase: I would like a latte, please.
expressions.example: I would like a medium hot mocha, please.
What size do you want? Large, please.

expressions.phrase: Would you like it hot or iced?
expressions.meaning_en: The worker asks about the temperature.
expressions.example: Would you like it hot or iced? Iced, please.

expressions.phrase: Is it for here or to go?
expressions.meaning_en: Will you stay or take it out?
expressions.example: Is it for here or to go? To go, please.

expressions.phrase: Would you like cream with that?
expressions.example: Would you like sugar with that?

expressions.phrase: Your order will be ready soon.
expressions.example: Your coffee will be ready soon.

grammar.title: I would like = I want (polite)
grammar.explanation_ar: I would like تعني أريد لكنها أكثر أدبًا من I want. نستخدمها عند الطلب في المقهى والمطعم. الاختصار: I'd like.
grammar.explanation_en: "I would like" means "I want", but it is more polite. Short form: "I'd like".
examples: I would like a latte, please.

grammar.title: Short answers when ordering
grammar.explanation_ar: عند الإجابة عن سؤال البائع يمكن أن نقول كلمة واحدة مع please: Medium, please. / Hot, please. / To go, please.
grammar.explanation_en: You can answer the worker with one word plus "please".

questions.question: "Would you like it hot or iced?" Which answer is correct?
questions.explanation_ar: السؤال عن ساخن أو مثلج، والإجابة: Iced, please.
questions.explanation_en: The question is about hot or iced.

questions.question: Which is the most polite?
choices: I would like a latte, please.
questions.explanation_ar: I would like ... please مهذبة جدًا.
questions.explanation_en: "I would like ..., please" is very polite.

questions.question: What is a mocha?
questions.explanation_en: A mocha is coffee with chocolate and milk.

questions.question: What size do you want? Small, medium, or ____?
questions.explanation_en: The sizes are small, medium and large.

questions.question: "Got it!" means ...
choices: I have it in my bag.

questions.question: "Is it for here or to go?" "____"
questions.explanation_ar: السؤال عن المكان، والإجابة To go أو For here.
questions.explanation_en: The answer is "to go" or "for here".

questions.question: The worker says: "Here you go." He is ...
questions.explanation_ar: Here you go تقال عند إعطاء شيء.
questions.explanation_en: We say "Here you go" when we give something.
